name: KMS decrypt with NotResource scope + conditional Deny (boundary)
note: IAM-504 fixture matrix: KMS-DECRYPT NotResource + explicit-Deny cells in one witness. Statement 0 allows kms:Decrypt on NotResource (everything except one pinned key) - broad, so KMS-DECRYPT fires and WILDCARD-RESOURCE is subsumed into it. Statement 1 is a CONDITIONAL Deny on kms:Decrypt: a conditional Deny may not apply at runtime, so it does NOT definitively suppress the capability (KMS-DECRYPT survives in the authoritative table) but it exercises the rule's interaction with an explicit Deny.
